entry.summary: No Smartraveller page and no current Kiribati government page found. Secondary sites say Australians enter visa-free, some for 30 days and some for 90 days under a 2023 Visa Exemption Order.
entry.next_check: Ask the Kiribati Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration, or the Kiribati High Commission, which stay applies.
entry.note: The Kiribati tourism office's visa page now redirects to an unrelated site and wasn't used.

seasons-and-flow.notes: At Tarawa the wet season, called Aumeang, usually runs November to April, peaking in January; the driest six months start in June. Visitor flow (peak and quiet months) is still to be read from the tourism authority's statistics.

sources.title: Climate change in the Pacific, Volume 2, Ch6-Kiribati
sources.authority: Pacific Climate Change Science Program (Australian Bureau of Meteorology and CSIRO), 2011
